finalTranscript: Good morning. For almost a hundred years, one English company has fought a single enemy. The Wrinkle. It's in millions of hotel rooms. Here's how it works. Open the press, lay the trousers on the heated pad, and close. 15 minutes, 30, or 45. 45 is for, and I quote, the even more difficult wrinkles. 45 minutes, one pair of trousers at a time. The heated pad was inspired by Concorde, for trousers. In walnut, mahogany, black ash, beech, or oak. Done. Steamed it in the shower. 44 minutes to go. The manual is very clear. Never use it in a bathroom. In the bathroom, the Corby never loses. It isn't allowed in. The manual also forbids dampening the trousers, but admits that humidity helps the pressing. Which is why the previous model came with an iron, a steam iron. 189 pounds 60, four pounds 20 a minute. Much cheaper than a Concorde. You didn't need it. Until now.
